top_signals.title: ShipStation first to bundle LTL into parcel shipping platform
top_signals.summary:
ShipStation, a provider of automated shipping services, is enabling customers to select less-than-truckload carriers and tender shipments on its parcel platform, marking the first concrete integration of services since the merger with WWEX Group this year.
